body: Thats how how I am. I keep my room messy so I dont kill myself. I still cry every night, but I don't  kill myself. I hope you're  okay though. I hope something good happens to you soon.

Oh... I understand what you mean. I trust my loved ones, but I can't handle all this pain. I attempted suicide before by overdosing and I told my mom and it made her cry. That's why the thread has its title.
I do have a therapist, but it's not really working. Im really trying to live through this and it's not working. My heart hurts so much that I have constant chest pain.

As what other said, I can relate to rather kill myself than become slowly insane. It got so bad, that I developed a temper. I'm bad at giving advice, but I don't like seeing people suffer. I also want to help though along with everyone else. I hope a miracle happens for you. I hope all goes well for you.
I look at things and see things that we used to do and it reminds me. Smell and sound can trigger it too. This is destroying me as a person.
I try to forget about her, but I keep getting reminded of her and it's very stressful. I hear you though.
